title: dump-pp-lex
summary: Diagnostic dump of the preprocessor lexer; the documented preprocessor verbs are preprocess-file and pp-profile
intro: Read this only when debugging preprocessor handling of a source file: dump-pp-lex --file PATH dumps the preprocessor lexer output. It is a diagnostic; the documented preprocessor verbs are preprocess-file and pp-profile.

questions.ask: How does the preprocessor lexer tokenise this file?

notes: internal: diagnostic: preprocessor lexer dump. The documented preprocessor verbs are preprocess-file and pp-profile.; seed: group guessed
